contrasts.ordinary: candidate minus declared repair from the same complete training state

effects.additive: calibration mean direction evaluated on untouched confirmation training units
effects.repair_aligned: energy-weighted candidate-minus-repair gain relative to the repair signal
effects.residual_direction: confirmation effect after removing same-state repair-aligned gain, projected on a calibration-only residual direction

inference.fixed_suite: descriptive effects only; no population confidence interval
inference.population_unit: independent training run or independently captured training-state cluster
inference.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student interval over independent-unit effects
inference.multiplicity: Holm within a family committed before results

large_vector_summary.required_robustness: repeat selected headline effects with at least two additional seeds or exact full-vector Gram

legacy_boundary: All v1 intervals and fixed-sketch results remain exploratory and are not silently relabeled under v2.
